0: Khlestakov and the Judge. JUDGE [comes in and stops. Talking to himself]. Oh, God, bring me safely out of this! How my knees are knocking together! [Drawing himself up and holding the sword in his hand. Aloud.] I have the honor to present myself—Judge of the District Court here, College Assessor Liapkin-Tiapkin.
1: KHLESTAKOV. Please be seated. So you are the Judge here?
2: JUDGE. I was elected by the nobility in 1816 and I have served ever since.
3: KHLESTAKOV. Does it pay to be a judge?
4: JUDGE. After serving three terms I was decorated with the Vladimir of the third class with the approval of the government. [Aside.] I have the money in my hand and my hand is on fire.
5: KHLESTAKOV. I like the Vladimir. Anna of the third class is not so nice.
6: JUDGE [slightly extending his balled fist. Aside]. Good God! I don't know where I'm sitting. I feel as though I were on burning coals.
7: KHLESTAKOV. What have you got in your hand there?
8: AMMOS [getting all mixed up and dropping the bills on the floor]. Nothing.
9: KHLESTAKOV. How so, nothing? I see money has dropped out of it.
10: AMMOS [shaking all over]. Oh no, oh no, not at all! [Aside.] Oh, Lord! Now I'm under arrest and they've brought a wagon to take me.
11: KHLESTAKOV. Yes, it IS money. [Picking it up.]
12: AMMOS [aside]. It's all over with me. I'm lost! I'm lost!
13: KHLESTAKOV. I tell you what—lend it to me.
14: AMMOS [eagerly]. Why, of course, of course—with the greatest pleasure. [Aside.] Bolder! Bolder! Holy Virgin, stand by me!
15: KHLESTAKOV. I've run out of cash on the road, what with one thing and another, you know. I'll let you have it back as soon as I get to the village.
16: AMMOS. Please don't mention it! It is a great honor to have you take it. I'll try to deserve it—by putting forth the best of my feeble powers, by my zeal and ardor for the government. [Rises from the chair and draws himself up straight with his hands hanging at his sides.] I will not venture to disturb you longer with my presence. You don't care to give any orders?
18: JUDGE. I mean, would you like to give orders for the district court here?
19: KHLESTAKOV. What for? I have nothing to do with the court now. No, nothing. Thank you very much.
20: AMMOS [bowing and leaving. Aside.]. Now the town is ours.
21: KHLESTAKOV. The Judge is a fine fellow.
